subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should the public meeting-runtime permission-plan contract require a breaking `meetingUrl` parameter now, or should the URL-aware capability be introduced compatibly?
rationale: The PR needs exact-origin permissions for Teams, but making the new input mandatory breaks existing external adapter implementations and requires an explicit SDK compatibility decision.

options.title: Make the contract additive
options.body: Keep existing adapters source-compatible by making the URL input optional or introducing a compatible new hook, while the core supplies it to updated adapters.

options.title: Accept a breaking SDK change
options.body: Land the required parameter only with explicit maintainer approval, a documented upgrade path, and compatibility coverage for plugin authors.

recommendation.title: Make the contract additive
recommendation.body: Keep existing adapters source-compatible by making the URL input optional or introducing a compatible new hook, while the core supplies it to updated adapters.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged Teams adapter and the current public meeting-runtime contract change.
